world_growth_v8.key_result: certificate lifetime under future world growth is determined by threat count and expansion direction

target_aware_planner_v7.key_result: evidence should be selected relative to the ecological target rather than complete world identity

scientific_question: Can a diagnostic measurement have little or no value for reducing the current survivor-world fiber yet have high value for protecting current ecological certificates against future expansion of the admitted world universe?

analysis_base.current_universe_B0: reference q70 truth-barrier world for every baseline-compatible source
analysis_base.future_growth_universe: the v8 all_source_full compatible candidate pool
analysis_base.baseline_certificates: all B0 robust-reachable and robust-impossible unobserved locally permissive nodes

S_source.current_effect: retain only B0 worlds with truth source
S_source.future_effect: retain only future candidate worlds with truth source

B_barrier.current_effect: B0 is unchanged because every B0 reference world already uses the truth barrier level
B_barrier.future_effect: retain only future candidate worlds with truth barrier level

R_analyst.current_effect: B0 is unchanged because every B0 reference world already uses q70
R_analyst.future_effect: retain only future candidate worlds using q70

action_objectives.current_contraction: fraction of B0 worlds eliminated by the truth-consistent action outcome
action_objectives.future_proofing: mean normalized expected world-growth lifetime across the baseline universal certificates after filtering both B0 and the all-source future growth pool by the truth-consistent action outcome
action_objectives.immortalization: number of baseline certificates whose threat count changes from K>0 before the action to K=0 after the action

lifetime_rule: reuse exact v8 threat-count lifetime: K=0 gives normalized lifetime 1; otherwise ((N+1)/(K+1))/N for N future additions

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: For every baseline certificate and each of the three actions, normalized future world-growth lifetime after the truth-consistent action is >= its pre-action lifetime.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any violation is an implementation/theory failure.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one row has B_barrier or R_analyst with zero current B0 contraction but a strictly positive mean future-lifetime gain.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if every zero-current-contraction action also has zero future-proofing value.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one row has a different tie-broken optimal action for current B0 contraction versus mean future certificate lifetime.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if the two objectives always select the same action.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one eligible row selects B_barrier or R_analyst as the future-proof-optimal action.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if S_source is always future-proof optimal.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one eligible row selects S_source as the future-proof-optimal action.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if source evidence is never future-proof optimal.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one truth-consistent action converts at least one baseline certificate from K>0 to K=0 under its filtered future growth pool.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if no threatened certificate can be fully protected by any single action.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Across eligible rows, at least two of S_source, B_barrier and R_analyst occur as the future-proof-optimal action.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if one action is always optimal.

secondary_outputs: rows where a zero-current-effect action is future-proof optimal
agreement with the older reachability-target adaptive planner first action
claim_boundary: Actions are known-truth diagnostic interventions with unit conceptual cost, not field-cost-equivalent measurements.
Future-proof value is conditional on the frozen v8 candidate growth pool.
An action that filters future analyst worlds may represent model validation rather than a literal ecological field measurement.
Truth-path leverage is a known-truth diagnostic quantity, not an expected pre-outcome utility.
stop_rules: Do not change the action library after scoring.
Do not replace mean normalized lifetime with a favorable alternative objective after scoring.
Do not add action weights after scoring.
Do not change the frozen B0 or future growth pool after scoring.
